title: Slack Candidate Tracker
description: Candidate Tracker is a self-hostable Slack app that logs candidates, moves them through a defined interview pipeline, and automatically creates a dedicated private channel with the right interviewers invited the moment they reach stage 1.

title: Slackbot Skill Service CS Account Risk
description: A Slackbot skill for support/CS teams: give it a customer name and it assembles a risk-flagged brief — ticket history, Slack mentions, CRM account health, and recent email tone — so a manager can see how serious a situation is without digging through different tools.

title: Localized Product Lwc
description: An AI-enabled Lightning Web Component (LWC) that leverages Prompt Builder to generate localized product summaries and positioning bullets for global sales reps and community catalogs.

title: Agentforce Architecture And Strategy
description: Discovery, architecture, and strategy guidance for designing and delivering Agentforce solutions

title: Permishifizer 9000
description: Generate a "Salesforce Backup" permission set XML from live org metadata — ensuring your backup/restore integration user has access to every restorable object, field, and record type.

title: Agentforce Readiness Assessment
description: A 7-dimension scoring rubric and facilitation guide for assessing whether a Salesforce org is ready to deploy Agentforce. Covers data quality, Data Cloud and Einstein Trust Layer setup, permissions, automation conflicts, Topic/Action maturity, governance, and change management, plus a cost-estimation appendix for Data Cloud and Agentforce budgets.

title: Campus Policy Navigator Prompt
description: Agentforce Education prompt that helps students, faculty, and staff navigate academic holds, registration windows, and    institutional policy using verified Salesforce records.

title: Inactive User Deactivator
description: This solution automates the deactivation of Salesforce users who have not logged into the organization for a configurable number of days. The objective is to improve security, optimize license utilization, and ensure compliance with organizational access management policies.

title: Custom Confetti
description: Give your users confetti they can get excited about. No developer required — pick the field and trigger value, and it showers them with a custom-coloured celebration. Every colour lives in Custom Metadata, so it's yours to reskin from Setup, any time.
